The '''1960 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 74th staging of the All-Ireland [[hurling]] championship since its establishment by the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]] in 1887. The championship began on 10 April 1960 and ended on 4 September 1960.

[[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] were the [[1959 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]], however, they were defeated in the provincial championship. [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] won the title after defeating [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] by 2–15 to 0–11 in the [[1960 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|All-Ireland final]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=28 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }}</ref>

===Scoring===

*Widest winning margin: '''32 points''' 
**Tipperary 10–9 – 2–1 Limerick (<small>''Munster quarter-final, 3 July 1960''</small>)
*Most goals in a match: '''13''' 
**Waterford 9–8 – 4–8 Galway (<small>''Munster quarter-final, 26 June 1960''</small>)
*Most points in a match: '''26''' 
**Wexford 2–15 – 0–11 Tipperary (<small>''All-Ireland final, 4 September 1960''</small>)
*Most goals by one team in a match: '''10''' 
**Tipperary 10–9 – 2–1 Limerick (<small>''Munster quarter-final, 3 July 1960''</small>)
*Most goals scored by a losing team: '''4''' 
**Galway 4–8 – 9–8 Waterford (<small>''Munster quarter-final, 26 June 1960''</small>)
**Cork 4–11 – 4–13 Tipperary (<small>''Munster final, 31 July 1960''</small>)

===Miscellaneous===

* [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]]'s defeat of [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] in the All-Ireland final is their first championship victory over Tipperary.
